item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0002-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Brazilian Senate record lists the CPMI on the acts of January 8, 2023 as closed, shows Senator Eliziane Gama’s final report as approved on October 17, 2023, and lists opposition separate opinions as not considered.","notes":["The excerpt does not explicitly state when or how the commission was established, so that attribution was removed.","The approval date, closed status, authorship, and non-consideration of the listed separate opinions are supported."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0002-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The meeting date, participating organizations and authorities, presentation of 2022 inspection results, and discussion of safeguards implementation challenges associated with expanding nuclear installations are all supported by the excerpt."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0002-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the 2024 UNDP paper’s claims about worsening labor-market inequalities during COVID-19, amplified fragilities and insecurity among vulnerable groups, the listed intersectional dimensions, and its focus on Black women."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0002-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the census’s annual and national scope, INEP coordination, partnerships with state and municipal secretariats and public and private schools, mandatory reporting, use of school administrative records, and the last Wednesday of May 2023 reference date."]}]}
